fire: I decided to start this blog so that I can share recipes.
We made a list so that we can check it later.
I saved the file so that I can find it again.
She wrote the steps down so that she can repeat them.
I took notes so that I can review them tonight.
We labelled the jars so that we can sort them.
I kept the receipt so that I can return it.
He set an alarm so that he can wake early.
quiet: I decided to start this blog and I share recipes.

I saved the file and I found it again.
She wrote the steps down and she repeated them.
I took notes and I reviewed them tonight.
We labelled the jars and we sorted them.
I kept the receipt and I returned it.
